title: Great output
text:
Great output. I’ve been on the search for a good humidifier for my bedroom. I found out by accident that having a humidifier helps me sleep so much better. So my search began. I found one on Amazon that worked miracls. For the first time in decades I was sleeping thru the night, not waking every hour or 2 and I woke up feeling rested. My miravle find worked for 2 weeks and then it quit working. The company quickly sent me another, which quit after 2 weeks.
So my search began again. After reading the reviews I decided to take a chance on this one. The mist output on high is substantial. I put it together, placed it on my kitchen counter to see how good it was and left to go out for supper. I got home a couple hours later and my counter was WET, as if something spilled wet. I took it to my room and placed a towel on the floor hoping that would protect my carpet. The towel was soaking wet this morning. I do think I slept better than I have the last couple weeks, but nothing like the first one. I’ll continue using it and set the humidity level lower in hopes of not having so much condensation on my carpet while still being able to produce enough humidity for me to sleep well. I’ll update in the future.
